title: Nature's Beauty — Photo Slideshow
description: Image-only slideshow with still photos and Ken Burns effect. Uses images:true flag for static visual mode. Perfect for landscape photography, travel highlights, and portfolio showcases.
script:

Deserts hold secrets beneath their sands. [Visual: vast desert sand dunes sunset] [Transition: fade] [Grade: warm]

Protect our planet — every action counts. [Visual: earth from space blue marble] [Transition: fade] [Grade: cinematic]
